description: In this feature, we have listed some of the best colour printers for home use in India. The list includes popular and recent models from brands such as HP, Canon, Brother, and others across different price segments. Readers can compare the specifications, features, and prices to choose the printer that best suits their needs. Most of them offer print, copy and scan functionalities.
title: Best Colour Printers for Home Use in India From Top Brands Like HP, Canon, Epson and Brother

description: iPhone 19e, which is expected to be launched globally in 2028, will be equipped with an LTPO (Low-Temperature Polycrystalline Oxide) TFT OLED display, according to a report citing industry sources. Moreover, a purported iPhone Air model, which could arrive in 2028, might launch with an LTPO+ panel, coupled with “Color Filter on Encap (CoE)” technology. However, Apple has yet to confirm these details. This comes weeks after the iPhone 17e was launched in India with a 6.1-inch LTPS OLED display.
title: Apple's iPhone 19e Said to Launch in 2028 With Upgraded LPTO OLED Display

description: Embark Studios CEO has said that some of Arc Raiders' AI-generated voice lines were re-recorded with human actors after the launch of the game. The Embark boss said that human actors were much better than AI. "“There is a quality difference. A real professional actor is better than AI; that's just how it is,” he said.
title: Arc Raiders' AI Voice Lines Were Re-Recorded by Human Actors After Launch, Says Embark CEO

description: With each new generation, Google has introduced an increasing number of artificial intelligence (AI) features in Pixel phones. The latest Pixel 10 series or last year’s Pixel 9 series offer a large number of AI-driven tools and experiences that users can make a part of their daily usage. But in recent times, one of the most popular features is the AI-generated notification summaries.
title: How to Enable AI-Powered Notification Summaries on Your Google Pixel Phones

description: Realme C100 5G could launch soon, and the smartphone has already appeared on an e-commerce website in Europe, disclosing its price, specifications, and colour options. The listing shows the phone with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and a 6.8-inch display. It has a 7,000mAh battery and a 50-megapixel rear camera unit. It is listed in two shades with IP64 rating for dust and water resistance.
title: Realme C100 5G Listed on Retail Website With 6.8-Inch Display and 7,000mAh Battery

description: Token holders of World Liberty Financial have approved a governance proposal introducing staking incentives and lock-up requirements for WLFI tokens. The measure requires participants to stake tokens for a set period to take part in governance decisions. The initiative also introduces a tiered node system designed to encourage long-term participation in the protocol.
title: WLFI Governance Vote Passes Proposal Introducing Token Lock-Up Incentives

description: The Xiaomi Book Pro 14 and Xiaomi Watch S5 smartwatch will be launched in China later this month. Through teaser posts on its social media, design and key specifications of the upcoming devices were revealed ahead of their anticipated debut. The Xiaomi Notebook Pro 14 will arrive with a 14.6-inch OLED display and support for up to 4TB SSD storage. The Watch S5 is positioned as a new addition to the smartwatch lineup with health and fitness tracking capabilities.
title: Xiaomi Book Pro 14, Xiaomi Watch S5 China Launch Date Announced; Key Features Teased

description: Anthropic is currently running a limited-time promotional event, under which it is offering all Claude users double the usage limits. The San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) firm said on Sunday that for the next two weeks, users will be able to take advantage of increased rate limits across all the different interfaces of the platform.
title: Anthropic Doubles Claude’s Usage Limits for the Next Two Weeks: Details

description: An Australian Senate committee has recommended passing a new bill aimed at regulating cryptocurrency platforms under the country’s financial services framework. The proposed legislation would introduce licensing and compliance requirements for exchanges and custody providers handling digital assets. If approved by Parliament, the bill could bring the crypto sector under oversight similar to traditional financial institutions.
title: Australian Lawmakers Advance New Bill to Regulate Crypto Platforms

description: JBL Grip has launched in India as an ultra-portable Bluetooth speaker priced at Rs. 11,999. It supports AI Sound Boost and Auracast for stereo and multi-speaker pairing and delivers a claimed 16W output. The speaker uses a 43 × 80mm full-range driver and offers a 70Hz–20kHz frequency response. Connectivity includes Bluetooth 5.4 and support for the JBL Portable app. It is rated IP68 for water and dust resistance and offers up to 12 hours of playback, with two additional hours available through Playtime Boost.
title: JBL Grip Portable Speaker With AI Sound Boost, Up to 12 Hours Battery Life Launched in India: Price, Features

description: The Oppo Find X9 Ultra is confirmed to launch in China soon as the top-of-the-line model in the flagship Find X9 series. While the company has yet to reveal details about its upcoming handset, a tipster has shed light on the periscope telephoto sensor, which is expected to headline its optics system. The Oppo Find X9 Ultra is tipped to be equipped with a 10x periscope telephoto shooter with an f/3.5 aperture.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Tipped to Get 10x Periscope Telephoto Camera With Larger Aperture Than Galaxy S23 Ultra

description: Poco X8 Pro Max 5G and Poco X8 Pro 5G, which are scheduled to be launched in select global markets on March 17, will be equipped with 50-megapixel dual rear camera units, the Chinese tech firm announced on Monday. The company also confirmed that the Poco X8 Pro Max 5G will be offered in 12GB+256GB and 12GB+512GB RAM and storage configurations, while the Pro model will be sold in 8GB+256GB, 8GB+512GB, and 12GB+512GB options globally. The handsets are set to be unveiled in India on the same day. However, the global and Indian counterparts of the phones might feature slightly different specifications.
title: Poco X8 Pro, Poco X8 Pro Max Camera Configuration and Display Features Revealed

description: Resident Evil Requiem has now sold over 6 million copies, Capcom has confirmed. The survival horror game has also become the fastest title in the Resident Evil franchise to reach the sales milestone. Requiem launched on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on February 27 and went on to sell 5 million copies in 5 days.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Sales Cross 6 Million Copies, Capcom Announces

description: Samsung launched the Galaxy S26 series last month with Android 16-based One UI 8.5. Now, the company is said to be testing Android 17-based One UI 9 on the Galaxy S26 lineup. The build reportedly spotted with version numbers S948BXXU1BZC5, S948BOXM1BZC5 and S948BXXU1BZC5. The stable rollout could happen in September. Samsung's next-generation foldable smartphones are likely to come with One UI 9 pre-installed.
title: Samsung Begins Testing One UI 9 Beta for Galaxy S26 Ultra Ahead of Android 17 Release: Report

description: Huawei has confirmed that the Huawei Enjoy 90 Pro Max and Huawei Enjoy 90 Plus will launch in China on March 23. The launch event will begin at 2:30pm local time (4:30pm IST). Both smartphones are confirmed to feature Kirin chipsets and run the HarmonyOS operating system. Teaser posts also suggest that battery capacity will be a major highlight of the upcoming devices. The Huawei Enjoy 90 Plus is confirmed to feature a 50-megapixel rear camera unit. The company has also started accepting pre-reservations for the upcoming phones.
title: Huawei Enjoy 90 Pro Max, Enjoy 90 Plus Launch Date Announced; Confirmed to Feature Kirin Processors

description: iQOO Z11x 5G is now on sale in India via Amazon, the iQOO online store, and the Vivo exclusive offline stores, the Vivo sub-brand announced on Monday. The smartphone is available for purchase in the country in Prismatic Green and Titan Black colour options. Launched in India on March 12, the iQOO Z11x 5G can be purchased by customers at a discounted price with select credit cards of Axis Bank and SBI. Moreover, the company is also offering up to six months of interest-free EMI options. The phone is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset, which is built on a 4nm process. It packs a 7,200mAh battery.
title: iQOO Z11x 5G With 7,200mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Microsoft has reportedly shifted its artificial intelligence (AI) strategy for Windows 11. As per the report, the Redmond-based tech giant is not planning to ship Copilot Suggestions in notifications any longer. This feature was first previewed by the company in 2024, but it has yet to show up even in the beta build of the Windows operating system.
title: Microsoft Reportedly Ditched Copilot Suggestions in Notifications to Reduce AI Bloat in Windows 11

description: Motorola Razr 70 has appeared on China’s 3C certification database with model number XT2657-2, revealing support for 33W wired charging. Earlier TENAA and TDRA listings suggested the handset may retain most specifications of the Razr 60. It is expected to feature a 6.9-inch OLED main display, a 3.63-inch cover screen, and a 4,500mAh typical battery. The foldable could include dual 50-megapixel rear cameras, a 32-megapixel selfie camera, a 2.75GHz octa-core chipset, and RAM options up to 18GB with storage reaching 1TB.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Reportedly Appears on 3C Certification Website; Could Arrive With Minor Charging Upgrade

description: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has dismissed its civil fraud lawsuit against BitClout founder Nader Al-Naji. The case accused him of raising $257 million  (roughly Rs. 2,374 crore) through the sale of the project’s native token while allegedly misleading investors about how the funds would be used. The case was dismissed with prejudice, meaning the regulator cannot bring the same charges again.
title: US SEC Drops Fraud Case Against BitClout Founder Nader Al-Naji

description: Bethesda seems to be gearing up to announce Starfield for PS5. The studio said over the weekend that it would share more on the game "next week." An official announcement on the game's rumoured PS5 port and next major update could arrive this week. Bethesda will reportedly launch Starfield on PS5 in April.
title: Bethesda Says It Will Share More on Starfield This Week, Suggesting PS5 Version Is Imminent

description: Bitcoin traded near $74,000 on Monday as institutional demand and steady macroeconomic signals supported the crypto market. Analysts said strong ETF inflows and whale accumulation are helping stabilise prices above the $70,000 level. Ethereum and major altcoins also gained, while investors continue to monitor macroeconomic developments and central bank policy signals.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $74,000 as Institutional Demand and Whale Activity Support Crypto Market

description: Instagram has announced that it will discontinue support for end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) starting in May 2026. The feature, first introduced in 2022, encrypts conversations in direct messages (DMs) so that no one, including Meta, can read them. The recently announced change means that encrypted chats currently available on the platform will no longer be supported after that date. Users whose conversations are affected will receive instructions on how to download any messages or media they want to keep before the feature is removed.
title: Instagram to Discontinue End-to-End Encryption for DMs on May 8: What It Means for You

description: Microsoft is reportedly planning to expand its Gaming Copilot AI assistant to the current generation consoles this year. As per the report, the Redmond-based tech giant wants to bring its artificial intelligence (AI)-powered gaming chatbot to more users and will be integrating the tool within the Xbox Series S and the Xbox Series X.
title: Microsoft’s Gaming Copilot AI Assistant is Coming to Current-Generation Xbox Consoles in 2026: Report

description: OnePlus has teased the launch of its new Nord series phones, which are expected to be the OnePlus Nord 6 and Nord CE 6. Separately, the OnePlus Nord CE 6 has reportedly received approval from the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). The phone was reportedly listed on the BIS certification website with the CPH2805 model number. This corroborates a recent report that suggested that the OnePlus Nord 6 series will be launched in India later this year, in April. The rumoured Nord CE 6 is said to arrive in the country as the rebranded version of the China-exclusive OnePlud Turbo 6V. The handset is expected to be equipped with a 6.78-inch flat OLED LTPS display.
title: OnePlus Nord 6 Series India Launch Teased; OnePlus Nord CE 6 Reportedly Visits BIS Database

description: Realme P4 Lite 5G will be launched in India on March 19 at 12 pm IST, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Monday. The smartphone is confirmed to be available for purchase in the country via Flipkart and the Realme India online store. On top of this, the company has started teasing the key specifications and features of the upcoming handset. The Realme P4 Lite 5G is confirmed to be equipped with a 7,000mAh battery, which is significantly larger than the Realme P4 Lite 4G’s 6,300mAh battery. The phone will be offered in Mosaic Blue and Mosaic Green colour options.
title: Realme P4 Lite 5G India Launch Date Announced; Company Reveals Design and Battery Capacity

description: Samsung Galaxy A57 and Galaxy A37 could launch soon. Ahead of the formal launch, unboxing videos of the phones have gone live on social media platforms. The videos showcase the handsets with a familiar triple rear camera unit. The Galaxy A37 and Galaxy A57 feature Samsung’s ‘Key Island’ design with slightly raised power and volume buttons. They are expected to come with IP68 certification and AMOLED displays. They could run on Exynos chipsets
title: Samsung Galaxy A37, Galaxy A57 Design Surfaces via Hands-on Videos Ahead of Launch

description: Samsung’s rumoured Galaxy Wide Fold may introduce a wider, tablet-like design to the company’s foldable lineup. The handset is tipped to feature a 7.6-inch inner display with a 4:3 aspect ratio, a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, and a dual-cell battery with a typical capacity of around 4,800mAh. Software animations in One UI 9 reportedly recently suggested its design elements. The phone may launch alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Flip 8 later this year and could compete with Apple’s rumoured foldable iPhone.
title: Samsung Galaxy Wide Fold Tipped to Feature 7.6-Inch Display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC

description: WhatsApp is rolling out a new feature that enables users to send messages to those people who do not have a WhatsApp account, according to a feature tracker. The feature, dubbed Guest Chats, allows non-WhatsApp users to join the chat via a secure web link, eliminating the need to specifically create a WhatsApp account. Such chats are said to leverage a unique identifier for creating an encryption key, enabling the same end-to-end encryption that the platform applies to normal conversations.
title: WhatsApp Rolling Out Guest Chats for Temporary Conversations With Non-WhatsApp Users in Beta: Report

description: Apple MacBook Neo was launched earlier this month. Now, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says that he is doubtful that touch is being considered for Apple’s lowest-tier Mac. The popular MacBook Air may get the touchscreen first, but even that isn’t due to get an iPhone-style OLED screen for at least two years. Gurman says he would be surprised if the MacBook Neo gains a touchscreen within the next three years. Adding a touch display would increase the cost of the MacBook Neo.
title: Apple's MacBook Neo Unlikely to Get Touchscreen Upgrade Like Upcoming MacBook Pro Models: Mark Gurman

description: Huawei has confirmed that it will launch a new device in India soon, as a dedicated microsite for the device is now live on Flipkart. The microsite suggests that the company will unveil a tablet in the country, which is expected to be the Huawei MatePad 11.5 (2026). However, a tipster claims that the company is also planning to launch new smartphones, true wireless stereo (TWS), laptops, and smartbands in the future. If this is true, it would mark the end of a more than five-year-long hiatus, during which the company did not launch a single tablet in India.
title: Huawei MatePad 11.5 (2026) Tipped to Launch in India Soon as Company Teases Comeback via Flipkart

description: Meta is reportedly working on an interesting new feature for its artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot, Meta AI. As per the report, the platform is getting a new AI Detection feature, which, as the name suggests, can likely spot AI-generated content. The feature is reportedly under development and is not available to users.
title: Meta Is Reportedly Working on an AI Detector Tool for Meta AI

description: Realme is reportedly preparing to launch the Realme 16T 5G in India. The handset is said to have appeared on the BIS certification website with the model number RMX5268, suggesting an imminent launch. The listing does not reveal any specifications. The handset is expected to arrive in 6GB + 128GB, 8GB + 128GB, and 8GB + 256GB variants with Aurora Green, Starlight Black, and Starlight Red colour options. The phone is expected to succeed the existing Realme 15T 5G.
title: Realme 16T 5G India Launch Seems Imminent as Smartphone Surfaces on BIS Certification Database

description: Apple is expected to unveil the next iterations of its operating systems for iPhone, iPad, and other devices at the upcoming Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026. According to a seasoned journalist, the updates, ubiquitously known as iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, are unlikely to have a major redesign similar to last year’s Liquid Glass overhaul. Instead, the Cupertino-based tech giant will reportedly focus on refining the design introduced with iOS 26, while adding features exclusively for the rumoured iPhone Fold.
title: iOS 27, iPadOS 27 to Reportedly Skip Major Liquid Glass Changes; to Bring iPhone Fold Features

description: The OnePlus Nord 6 is rumoured to launch soon as the successor to the Nord 5, which was introduced in July 2025 in India and the global markets. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a tipster has shed light on the expected specifications of the purported handset. It is said to have a similar set of core internals as the OnePlus Turbo 6, which made its China debut in January and thus, could be a rebranded version of the aforementioned smartphone.
title: OnePlus Nord 6 Tipped to Have Same Specifications as China-exclusive OnePlus Turbo 6; May Launch in April
